meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用你从 cmem.ai → Connect 拿到的凭据配置 claude-mem-cowork 插件:把 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 写进插件的 config.json,让 hook 能捕获和注入记忆。本机若有本地 claude-mem,也可把同样的值写进它的 settings.json。
howto.when: 当你说「设置 claude-mem」「配对 claude-mem」「连接 cmem」等,或直接粘贴 cmem.ai Connect 里的凭据值时,它接管配置;凭据缺失时至少会向你要 sync token,另两个可选。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem,用我的 cmem 凭据
say.note: 它会问你要 sync token 等值

say.text: 检查一下 cmem 的配对状态
say.note: 它会报告打码后的状态输出

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin with your cmem.ai credentials: it writes the sync token, user id and SyncHub URL into the plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up claude-mem, pair claude-mem, connect cmem, or paste your cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL). Missing values: it asks for the sync token at minimum.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my cmem credentials
say_en.note: It asks for your sync token

say_en.text: Here are my cmem Connect values: cm_..., user id, SyncHub URL

say_en.note: It reports the masked status output
